purpose: Teach: 一寸/やむなく/専ら/例える/かねてから/しなやか/でたらめ/おとなしい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは一寸照れ屋でいらしたぞ
lines.en: Your father was quite shy when he was young, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic recollection. Soft opening. Slow measured pace, as if touching an old memory carefully. Warm but distant, like looking at a photograph.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、やむなくお仕事を辞められたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you had to give up that job, didn't you?
lines.style: Tender inquiry wrapped in acceptance. Knowing tone, not questioning. Light, almost conversational. A question that already holds the answer, asked with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんは専ら書物の収集にお金を使われたぞ
lines.en: Your father spent almost all his money collecting books, you see.
lines.style: Reflective, matter-of-fact beneath the gentleness. Slight pause before the main point. Speaking as if recounting a character trait, not a criticism. Quiet pride in the observation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、人生を旅に例えるる事でいらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: He used to compare life to a journey, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm confirmation more than a question. Softly affirming. The rhythm of someone who has heard this idea many times and still finds it true. Gentle smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはかねてから故郷を想っていらしたぞ
lines.en: Even as a young man, your father was always thinking of his hometown.
lines.style: Distant, tender observation. The opening slightly weighted with longing. Even pace, no rush. Speaking as though that homesickness was both his nature and his nobility.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年もしなやかなお心をお持ちでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Even in his later years, he kept such a flexible, generous heart, didn't he?
lines.style: Affirming and admiring, quiet certainty. Not a question seeking information but one offering agreement. Warm tone, slight lengthening of the final phrase. Close, intimate address.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはでたらめなお話には乗らない方だったぞ
lines.en: Your father wasn't the sort to fall for nonsense, though.
lines.style: Slight firmness beneath affection. A gentle correction or clarification. Measured pace with a small lift of conviction on the negation. Protective respect in the tone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様は皆おとなしい子でしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: All of your grandchildren turned out to be such quiet, well-behaved kids, didn't they?
lines.style: Warm, satisfied observation. Close and intimate phrasing. Gentle pride in the statement. Soft trailing into the affectionate final address, as though tucking a memory in close.
